description: This file defines API endpoints related to user agent analytics, including retrieving distinct user agent tags, daily/weekly/monthly active users, tag summaries, and per-user analytics. It uses FastAPI with SQL queries via Prisma ORM to interact with the database and provides specialized endpoints for analytics dashboard functionality.

classes.name: TagActiveUsersResponse
classes.description: Response model for active user metrics per tag, including date and period coverage.

classes.name: ActiveUsersAnalyticsResponse
classes.description: Container for list of TagActiveUsersResponse objects, representing analytics over multiple tags and periods.

classes.name: TagSummaryMetrics
classes.description: Model representing summary metrics for a tag, including user counts, requests, tokens, and spend.

classes.name: TagSummaryResponse
classes.description: Container model for a list of TagSummaryMetrics objects.

classes.name: DistinctTagResponse
classes.description: Model defining a single distinct user agent tag.

classes.name: DistinctTagsResponse
classes.description: Container for list of DistinctTagResponse objects, representing all distinct user agent tags.

classes.name: PerUserMetrics
classes.description: Model encapsulating per-user analytics including request counts, tokens, spend, and user info.

classes.name: PerUserAnalyticsResponse
classes.description: Container for a list of PerUserMetrics, including pagination info.

methods.name: get_distinct_user_agent_tags( user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Fetches all distinct user agent tags from the database, returning a limited list ordered by frequency.

methods.name: get_daily_active_users( tag_filter: Optional[str] = Query( default=None, description="Filter by specific tag (optional)", ), tag_filters: Optional[List[str]] = Query( default=None, description="Filter by multiple specific tags (optional, takes precedence over tag_filter)", ), user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Returns daily active users per tag over the past {MAX_DAYS} days, with optional tag filtering.

methods.name: get_weekly_active_users( tag_filter: Optional[str] = Query( default=None, description="Filter by specific tag (optional)", ), tag_filters: Optional[List[str]] = Query( default=None, description="Filter by multiple specific tags (optional, takes precedence over tag_filter)", ), user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Provides weekly active user metrics over the last {MAX_WEEKS} weeks, with descriptive week labels.

methods.name: get_monthly_active_users( tag_filter: Optional[str] = Query( default=None, description="Filter by specific tag (optional)", ), tag_filters: Optional[List[str]] = Query( default=None, description="Filter by multiple specific tags (optional, takes precedence over tag_filter)", ), user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Returns monthly active user data over the last {MAX_MONTHS} months with label and period info.

methods.name: get_tag_summary( start_date: str = Query( description="Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format" ), end_date: str = Query( description="End date in YYYY-MM-DD format" ), tag_filter: Optional[str] = Query( default=None, description="Filter by specific tag (optional)", ), tag_filters: Optional[List[str]] = Query( default=None, description="Filter by multiple specific tags (optional, takes precedence over tag_filter)", ), user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Provides aggregate tag analytics over a specified date range, including user counts and requests.

methods.name: get_per_user_analytics( tag_filter: Optional[str] = Query( default=None, description="Filter by specific tag (optional)", ), tag_filters: Optional[List[str]] = Query( default=None, description="Filter by multiple specific tags (optional, takes precedence over tag_filter)", ), page: int = Query(default=1, description="Page number for pagination", ge=1), page_size: int = Query( default=50, description="Items per page", ge=1, le=1000 ), user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Fetches per-user usage metrics with pagination, based on activity within the last 30 days with tag filtering.
